title: Office Administrator
description:
Job description: ADMIN FURNITURE DEPT Department: Administration Location: Okhla , New Delhi Salary: Based on experience and skill level Gender: Female / Male Qualification: Graduate Working Hours: 10:00 AM to 6:30 PM (some flexibility appreciated) Job Description Assist in client relationship management and sales coordination. Support business development and follow\-up for leads and client inquiries. Document meeting notes, maintain client records, and track follow\-ups. Help prepare basic MIS reports and internal communication as needed. Coordinate client visits and assist during sales meetings. Manage client data and update CRM/database regularly. Help prepare basic letters, forms, and reports using MS Word and Excel. Coordinate logistics for meetings, travel, and client\-related requirements. Key Skills \& Competencies Good verbal and written communication skills (English \& Hindi). Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook). Strong time management and coordination ability. Ability to maintain confidentiality and professionalism. Familiarity with basic admin tasks like data entry, filing, and scheduling. Comfortable using phones, tablets, and other basic electronic devices. Willing to learn and support across departments when needed Essential Technical Skills: The candidate must have strong working proficiency in both Microsoft PowerPoint and Microsoft Excel. These are core requirements for the role and are non\-negotiable. PowerPointThe candidate should be able to work efficiently and independently, including: ● Creating and formatting professional presentations. ● Cropping and editing images. ● Removing image backgrounds. ● Setting up and managing page layouts and slide formatting. ● Arranging visual content in a clean, organized, and presentation\-ready manner. ExcelThe candidate should be proficient and work with speed and accuracy, including: ● Creating and managing spreadsheets. ● Using formulas and performing calculations. ● Working confidently with numerical data. ● Importing and inserting images where required. ● Formatting worksheets and maintaining organized data. The candidate will be assessed on these skills during the recruitment process. Strong proficiency in both PowerPoint and Excel is an essential requirement for this position.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Experience:

* Admin Sales: 2 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
